<!-- FORGE:INVESTIGATOR -->
## Investigation Report

| Field | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Verdict | CONFIRMED |
| Confidence | HIGH |
| Severity | HIGH |
| Task type | Bug Fix |
| Complexity | STANDARD |

### What Was Claimed

A required local verification command can be structurally valid while being impossible to run in a repository whose executable package and npm script live below the repository root. ForgeDock should detect that before launching a writer, support a trusted package working directory, and retain fail-closed verification behavior.

### What We Found

`VerificationCommandPolicy` currently carries only `argv`, `required`, and `timeoutMs`; the parser rejects an empty command map. The work-on controller prepares and materializes the writer worktree before any command feasibility check. The child binding has no command working-directory field and `forge_verify` always executes from the worktree root. `/forge:init` copies a template that unconditionally selects root `npm test`, without inspecting package manifests. There is no metadata-only verification preflight adapter or monorepo regression fixture in this base.

### Root Cause

Verification policy models a command's process invocation but not the package directory in which it is valid, and the launch path treats policy shape validation as sufficient feasibility validation. Consequently, a root `npm test` can pass config parsing and reach implementation before failing for a missing root script.

### Affected Files

| Path | Reason |
| --- | --- |
| `src/core/policy.ts` | Add a validated repository-relative command cwd and permit explicit CI-only empty local commands. |
| `src/adapters/verification-preflight.ts` | Add metadata-only executable, directory, package manifest, and npm-script checks with actionable config-path errors. |
| `src/workflows/work-on.ts` | Run required-command preflight before agent materialization and writer launch. |
| `src/agents/child-runtime.ts` | Bind, validate, contain, and use the approved command cwd during verification. |
| `src/ui/commands.ts` | Make `/forge:init` choose a root or unique nested package test script, otherwise emit CI-only local verification. |
| `templates/config.json` | Stop assuming that every repository has a root npm test script. |
| `test/fixtures/monorepo/*` and focused tests | Cover nested package discovery, preflight failures, cwd containment, and fail-closed compatibility. |
| `README.md`, `DESIGN.md`, `SECURITY.md` | Document package-scoped commands and the metadata-only trust boundary. |

### Evidence

- `parseForgePolicy` requires `verification.commands` to contain at least one command and has no cwd field.
- `ForgeWorkOnController.startIssue` calls `materializeForgeAgents` and then spawns the writer without a required-command feasibility check.
- `forge_verify` passes the assigned worktree root as `cwd` for every approved command.
- `/forge:init` copies `templates/config.json`, whose default command is root `npm test`; no package manifest discovery exists.
- Existing gate mapping converts an absent command result to `unknown`, so required checks remain blocking when results are missing or failed.
- The assigned base has no verification-preflight adapter or monorepo fixture.

### History Findings

The issue describes a failure mode consistent with the current code: structural policy validation occurs before execution, but package context is not represented or inspected. The requested change is bounded to policy, preflight, launch/runtime binding, initialization, tests, and documentation; it does not require changing merge authority or the existing required-check gate.

### Recommendation

Add a normalized repository-relative `cwd` to each verification command, default legacy commands to `.`, and allow an empty map as an explicit GitHub-CI-only mode. Implement a read-only preflight that checks every required command's executable, canonical cwd, package manifest, and recognized npm script without spawning it. Run it before writer materialization. Make init select only a root or unique nested package with the requested script; otherwise leave local commands empty. Revalidate cwd containment in the child and preserve unknown/failed required results as blocking.

### Related Issues

- None.

### Decomposition Assessment

**Required**: no — this is a single bounded policy and launch-safety change with focused regression coverage.

### Acceptance Spec

- [ ] Required verification commands support a validated repository-relative working directory.
- [ ] `/forge:init` never selects `npm test` without a matching package script; unique nested packages are supported and ambiguous/no matches use CI-only mode.
- [ ] Required local commands are preflighted for executable, cwd, package manifest, and npm script feasibility before any writer is launched, without executing repository code.
- [ ] Preflight errors name the exact config path and provide `/forge:init` or config remediation.
- [ ] A monorepo fixture covers a root without `test` and a nested package with `test`.
- [ ] Post-implementation required-check results remain fail-closed.

<!-- INVESTIGATION:COMPLETE -->
